animals.name: Alligator
animals.funFact: Can hold breath for 2 hours underwater!
animals.description: Alligators are powerful, armored river reptiles with strong swimming tails.

animals.name: Ant
animals.funFact: Ants never sleep and work together in big colonies!
animals.description: Ants are hardworking little insects famous for strength and teamwork.

animals.name: Alpaca
animals.funFact: Alpacas hum softly to communicate with their herd!
animals.description: Alpacas are gentle mountain animals with super soft coats.

animals.name: Asiatic Lion
animals.funFact: The Asiatic Lion lives in the wild only in India's Gir Forest!
animals.description: The Asiatic Lion is the majestic king of the Indian forest with a proud golden mane.

animals.name: Asiatic Elephant
animals.funFact: Indian elephants love bathing in rivers and spraying water!
animals.description: Asiatic Elephants are wise, gentle giants found across Indian forests.

animals.name: Bear
animals.superpower: Keen sense of smell & tree climbing
animals.funFact: Bears can smell honey from miles away!
animals.description: Bears are furry mammals with strong paws and great memory.

animals.name: Bee
animals.funFact: Bees communicate flower locations by dancing in a figure-8!
animals.description: Bees are busy flying insects that pollinate flowers and make delicious golden honey.

animals.name: Buffalo
animals.funFact: Water buffalo love wallowing in cool mud to protect their skin from the sun!
animals.description: The Water Buffalo is a strong, peaceful giant found across Indian rivers and farms.

animals.name: Bengal Tiger
animals.funFact: Every tiger has a completely unique stripe pattern!
animals.description: The Royal Bengal Tiger is a majestic orange cat with black stripes.

animals.name: Camel
animals.superpower: Stores energy in humps & survives desert heat
animals.funFact: Camels can drink 40 gallons of water in 10 minutes!
animals.description: Camels are resilient desert champions known as the Ships of the Desert.

animals.name: Cat
animals.funFact: Cats can jump up to 6 times their height in one leap!
animals.description: Cats are nimble, loving companion animals with soft paws and keen senses.

animals.name: Cow
animals.funFact: Cows have best friends and get happier when they are together!
animals.description: Cows are gentle, friendly farm animals that graze happily on green pastures.

animals.name: Cheetah
animals.funFact: A cheetah can accelerate faster than a sports car!
animals.description: The Cheetah is a spotted big cat known for incredible sprinting speed.

animals.name: Dolphin
animals.funFact: Dolphins sleep with one eye open and half their brain awake!
animals.description: Dolphins are playful, intelligent marine mammals that love leaping through ocean waves.

animals.name: Deer
animals.funFact: Deer can jump up to 10 feet high in a single leap!
animals.description: Deer are graceful forest herbivores with slender legs and keen senses.

animals.name: Elephant
animals.funFact: Elephants hug with their trunks and have super long memories!
animals.description: Elephants are gentle giant mammals with big flapping ears and long trunks.

animals.name: Eagle
animals.funFact: Eagles can spot a small rabbit from 2 miles high in the sky!
animals.description: Eagles are majestic birds of prey with huge wingspans and curved talons.

animals.name: Fox
animals.funFact: Foxes use their bushy tail like a cozy blanket in winter!
animals.description: Foxes are intelligent woodland mammals with rusty red fur and sharp pointy ears.

animals.name: Flamingo
animals.superpower: Balances gracefully on one slender leg
animals.funFact: Flamingos get their vibrant pink color from eating algae and shrimp!
animals.description: Flamingos are elegant wading birds famous for their pink feathers.

animals.name: Giraffe
animals.funFact: Giraffes sleep standing up for just 30 minutes a day!
animals.description: Giraffes are the tallest land animals on Earth with beautiful spotted coats.

animals.name: Giant Panda
animals.superpower: Super strong jaws to crunch bamboo shoots
animals.funFact: Pandas spend up to 12 hours every day munching on fresh bamboo!
animals.description: Giant Pandas are lovable black-and-white bears that love rolling and relaxing.

animals.name: Hippopotamus
animals.funFact: Hippos can hold breath underwater for 5 minutes while walking on riverbeds!
animals.description: Hippos are large, round mammals that stay cool submerged in fresh rivers.

animals.name: Horse
animals.funFact: Horses can run within hours after they are born!
animals.description: Horses are majestic, strong animals known for their flowing manes.

animals.name: Iguana
animals.funFact: Iguanas have a special 'third eye' on their head to detect birds flying above!
animals.description: Iguanas are large green lizards with spiky dorsal crests.

animals.name: Ibex
animals.superpower: Gravity-defying cliff climbing on steep rocks
animals.funFact: Ibex hooves act like suction cups on mountain walls!
animals.description: The Ibex is a wild mountain goat with magnificent backwards-curving horns.

animals.name: Jaguar
animals.funFact: Jaguars have rosette spots with small black dots inside them!
animals.description: Jaguars are the largest cats in the Americas with golden-yellow spotted coats.

animals.name: Jellyfish
animals.funFact: Jellyfish are older than dinosaurs!
animals.description: Jellyfish are mesmerizing translucent creatures that pulse peacefully.

animals.name: Kangaroo
animals.superpower: Giant bouncing hops & cozy front pouch
animals.funFact: Baby kangaroos are called 'joeys' and live in their mother's pouch!
animals.description: Kangaroos are famous bouncing marsupials with powerful back legs.

animals.name: Koala
animals.funFact: Koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day in tree branches!
animals.description: Koalas are adorable fluffy marsupials with round ears.

animals.name: Lion

animals.description: Lions are the majestic kings of the animal kingdom with proud manes.

animals.name: Leopard
animals.funFact: Leopards can climb down trees headfirst!
animals.description: Leopards are graceful big cats with golden fur covered in rosettes.

animals.name: Monkey

animals.description: Monkeys are energetic, playful animals that chatter and swing through trees.

animals.name: Meerkat
animals.funFact: Meerkats have natural dark 'sunglasses' around their eyes!
animals.description: Meerkats are small, social animals that stand tall to watch the horizon.

animals.name: Numbat
animals.funFact: Numbats have distinct white stripes across their back!
animals.description: Numbats are colorful, harmless marsupials with fluffy tails and banded stripes.

animals.name: Narwhal
animals.superpower: Arctic ocean diving & spiraled unicorn tusk
animals.funFact: The narwhal's horn is a giant sensory tooth with 10 million nerve endings!
animals.description: Known as the Unicorn of the Sea, narwhals are Arctic whales with a long spiral tusk.

animals.name: Owl
animals.funFact: Owls have specialized fringe feathers that make flight silent!
animals.description: Owls are wise nocturnal birds with large glowing eyes.

animals.name: Otter
animals.funFact: Sea otters hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift away!
animals.description: Otters are adorable river and sea mammals with thick waterproof fur.

animals.name: Peacock
animals.funFact: India's National Bird fans out shimmering feathers during rain!
animals.description: The Peacock displays a glorious turquoise and emerald fan of feathers.

animals.name: Penguin
animals.funFact: Emperor penguins huddle in huge circles to stay warm!
animals.description: Penguins are tuxedo-wearing flightless birds that excel at swimming.

animals.name: Quokka

animals.description: Quokkas are small, friendly marsupials famous for their cheerful smiling expressions.

animals.name: Quail

animals.description: Quails are small, plump game birds that forage peacefully on the ground.

animals.name: Red Ant

animals.description: Red Ants are tireless, hardworking insects known for underground architecture.

animals.name: Rabbit

animals.description: Rabbits are soft, gentle animals with long twitchy ears and fluffy cotton-ball tails.

animals.name: Snow Leopard
animals.superpower: Padded mountain paws & thick frosty fur
animals.funFact: Snow leopards can leap up to 50 feet across deep mountain ravines!
animals.description: Known as the Ghost of the Mountains, the Snow Leopard has smokey-gray spotted fur.

animals.name: Squirrel
animals.superpower: Tree sprinting & hidden acorn treasure maps
animals.funFact: Squirrels plant millions of trees by forgetting where they buried nuts!
animals.description: Squirrels are energetic, bushy-tailed rodents that scamper up trees.

animals.name: Tiger
animals.funFact: Tigers love swimming in cool forest rivers!
animals.description: Tigers are powerful striped apex predators with glowing amber eyes.

animals.name: Tortoise
animals.funFact: Some giant tortoises can live for over 150 years!
animals.description: Tortoises are wise, slow-moving reptiles protected by an unbreakable domed shell.

animals.name: Umbrellabird
animals.funFact: The male umbrellabird has a parasol-like crest of feathers on its head!
animals.description: Umbrellabirds are distinctive rainforest birds with a hood of feathers like an open umbrella.

animals.name: Urial
animals.funFact: Urials have large curling horns that can grow over 3 feet long!
animals.description: The Urial is a majestic wild mountain sheep native to central and southern Asia.

animals.name: Vulture
animals.superpower: Nature's greatest cleanup crew & gliding for hours
animals.funFact: Vultures have strong stomach acid that destroys bacteria and keeps ecosystems clean!
animals.description: Vultures are important soaring birds that keep wild ecosystems healthy and clean.

animals.name: Vervet Monkey

animals.description: Vervet Monkeys are intelligent, greenish-grey primates with black faces.

animals.name: Water Buffalo

animals.description: Water Buffaloes are strong, peaceful giants that love river waters.

animals.name: Wolf

animals.description: Wolves are intelligent, loyal pack mammals with thick gray coats and sharp senses.

animals.description: The X-Ray Tetra is a small, sparkling freshwater fish with transparent, glass-like skin.

animals.name: Yak

animals.description: Yaks are gentle, long-haired mountain oxen that thrive across Himalayan peaks.

animals.name: Yellow Canary
animals.superpower: Sweet musical singing melody & bright golden plumage

animals.description: The Yellow Canary is a cheerful songbird with bright sunshine-yellow feathers.

animals.name: Zebra

animals.description: Zebras are iconic African animals with striking black and white striped coats.

fruits.name: Fig

numbers.name: Number 0 — Zero (Shunya / Invention of Zero)
numbers.scientificName: Discovery of Zero by Aryabhata & Brahmagupta (Ancient India)
numbers.superpower: Universal Base of Mathematics, Binary Code & Space Exploration
numbers.funFact: Zero is the only number that is neither positive nor negative, and multiplying any number by 0 gives 0!
numbers.description: Who invented Zero? The concept of Zero (called 'Shunya' in Sanskrit, meaning void or sky) and the place-value decimal system were pioneered by ancient Indian mathematician-astronomer Aryabhata in the 5th century CE. In 628 CE, the great Indian astronomer Brahmagupta formulated the world's first mathematical rules and algebraic operations for Zero in his masterwork 'Brahmasphutasiddhanta'. This revolutionary Indian discovery traveled across the Arab world to Europe, giving humanity modern arithmetic, algebra, computers, and rocket navigation!

numbers.name: Number 1 — One (Ek)
numbers.funFact: 1 is the first odd number and the fundamental building block of all counting numbers!
numbers.description: Number 1 represents unity, origins, and the start of all numbers. In arithmetic, multiplying any number by 1 leaves it unchanged, making 1 the unique multiplicative identity element across all mathematics.

numbers.name: Number 2 — Two (Do)
numbers.scientificName: First Even Number & Only Even Prime Number
numbers.superpower: Foundation of Binary Code (0 and 1) running all digital technology
numbers.funFact: 2 is the only number in the entire universe that is both an even number and a prime number!
numbers.description: Number 2 is the base of the binary numeral system (Base-2) that powers every smartphone, computer chip, and internet server on planet Earth. It represents pairs, symmetry, and duality in nature.

numbers.name: Number 3 — Three (Teen)
numbers.funFact: Triangles with 3 sides are the strongest structural shapes used to build towering bridges and skyscrapers!
numbers.description: Number 3 forms the triangle, the only polygon that is inherently rigid and cannot be deformed without breaking its edges. It is fundamental in trigonometry, 3D space (X, Y, Z axes), and physics.

numbers.name: Number 4 — Four (Char)
numbers.superpower: First Composite Number & 4 Cardinal Directions (N, S, E, W)
numbers.funFact: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 interior right angles of 90 degrees that add up to 360 degrees!
numbers.description: Number 4 defines navigation through the four cardinal directions (North, South, East, West), the four seasons of nature (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter), and the perfect symmetry of a square.

numbers.name: Number 5 — Five (Paanch)
numbers.superpower: Pentagonal Golden Ratio & 5 Digits per Human Hand
numbers.funFact: Starfish, apple blossoms, and morning glory flowers all display natural 5-fold radial symmetry!
numbers.description: Number 5 is closely tied to human biology with 5 fingers on each hand, 5 toes on each foot, and the 5 senses (Sight, Hearing, Taste, Smell, Touch). It is also the basis of the pentagon and the golden ratio spiral.

numbers.name: Number 6 — Six (Chhah)
numbers.superpower: Hexagonal Tiling (Highest structural efficiency in nature)
numbers.funFact: Honeybees build their hives with 6-sided hexagons because it uses the least wax and holds the most honey!
numbers.description: Number 6 is the smallest 'perfect number' because the sum of its proper divisors equals itself (1 + 2 + 3 = 6). In nature, snowflakes and bee honeycombs always form 6-sided hexagonal geometry.

numbers.name: Number 7 — Seven (Saat)
numbers.superpower: Optical Dispersion of Light into 7 Distinct Spectral Colors
numbers.funFact: Sunlight passing through raindrops splits into exactly 7 spectral colors: Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, and Red!
numbers.description: Number 7 is celebrated across science and cultures: the 7 colors of the rainbow, the 7 days of the week, the 7 continents on Earth, and the 7 notes of the musical octave (Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Dha Ni).

numbers.name: Number 8 — Eight (Aath)
numbers.superpower: Sideways 8 forms the universal Infinity Symbol (∞)
numbers.funFact: When turned on its side, the number 8 becomes the mathematical lemniscate symbol for infinity (∞)!
numbers.description: Number 8 is the basis of an octagon (8 sides, like a stop sign), the 8 legs of an octopus and spider, and in computer science, 8 bits make up 1 byte of digital information.

numbers.name: Number 9 — Nine (Nau)
numbers.scientificName: Highest Single-Digit Decimal & Digital Root Magic
numbers.superpower: Magical Digital Root (Multiples of 9 always sum to 9)
numbers.funFact: In the 9 times table, adding the digits of any answer always equals 9 (e.g. 9 × 7 = 63 -> 6 + 3 = 9)!
numbers.description: Number 9 is the highest single-digit number in the decimal system. It holds unique mathematical properties: the sum of the digits of any multiple of 9 is always a multiple of 9.

numbers.name: Number 10 — Ten (Das)
numbers.scientificName: Base of the Universal Decimal Place-Value System
numbers.superpower: Foundation of the Global Metric System & Decimal Counting
numbers.funFact: Humans count in Base-10 (Decimal) worldwide because our ancient ancestors used their 10 fingers!
numbers.description: Number 10 is the foundation of the decimal numeral system and the metric system (meters, kilograms, liters). Combining 1 and 0, it represents completion and the transition to two-digit numbers.
